title: Critical Connections in a Network
summary: Given n servers numbered from 0 to n-1 connected by undirected server-to-server connections, where each connection is represented by a pair [ai, bi], identify all connections that, if removed, would cause some servers to become unreachable from others.
statement: Given n servers numbered from 0 to n-1 connected by undirected server-to-server connections, where each connection is represented by a pair [ai, bi], identify all connections that, if removed, would cause some servers to become unreachable from others.
hints: DFS discovery times identify ancestor order.
low[node] is the earliest discovery reachable through its subtree plus one back edge.
After visiting a child, its edge is a bridge exactly when child low is greater than parent discovery.
No alternate path then crosses that tree edge; every other edge lies on a cycle.
